entries.title: Reference oracle re-authorizes a history event and aborts on its policy error
entries.scope: This case only. FCN-05 remains TC-03 through TC-06.

upstreamObservation.error: history event `h-1` failed upstream evaluation: error while evaluating policy `expc14_1`: `Test::Item::"item-1"` does not have the attribute `owner`

entries.contractBasis: History replay is a trace; the current event is the only authorization request; entity conformance applies to present entities. The history event has no entities and the current request is valid.
entries.effect: Reference fails closed; D3 returns Allow for the valid current request. No current-request error is suppressed.
